description: This Java class 'ModifyFeatures' defines a command for modifying features of a 'Thing' in an Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, serializing the command to JSON, and handling command validation and equality checks.

classes.name: ModifyFeatures
classes.description: A command class that modifies all existing Features of a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the data and methods to serialize, deserialize, and handle modifying features via JSON representation and command pattern.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyFeatures for a given ThingId, Features, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyFeatures from a JSON string or JsonObject.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the Features object associated with this command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing this command targets.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity payload (Features) as an optional JsonValue, considering the schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload information to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ModifyFeatures command instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization, returns false.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the command instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality based on thingId and features.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality comparison, confirms object is instance of ModifyFeatures.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ModifyFeatures object.
